name: TRANSIT STATION INTERIOR
text: A dimly lit, concrete-heavy waiting area. The
glow of old technology and a space heater
provide the only comfort against the chill.

name: ILLUMINATED TRANSIT MAP
text: The bright blue and orange lines of the
transit network glow steadily. Some stations
are marked with blinking indicators,
suggesting intermittent service.

name: METAL FLOOR GRATING
text: Heavy metal grates cover a large section of
the floor. You can hear a faint hum and feel a
slight draft coming up from below.

name: WOODEN WALL SHELF
text: A simple wooden shelf holds an umbrella, a
thermos, a backpack, and a worn teddy bear.
Someone left their belongings here in a hurry.

name: WOODEN WAITING BENCH
text: A basic wooden bench sits against the wall.
Its surface is worn smooth from years of use
by weary travelers.

name: TICKET MACHINE TERMINAL
text: A bulky, retro-futuristic ticket machine. The
screen is dark, but a small yellow light
blinks on the control panel.

name: SECOND TICKET MACHINE
text: Another identical ticket machine stands next
to the first. It looks like it hasn't
dispensed a pass in a long time.

name: GLOWING SPACE HEATER
text: A small electric heater casts a warm orange
glow across the floor. It hums quietly,
fighting a losing battle against the damp
chill.

name: PAMPHLET DISPLAY RACK
text: A metal rack holds a few faded brochures and
schedules. The paper is yellowing and crisp to
the touch.
